System: High entropy oxide materials, specifically (Ni0.2Mg0.2Cu0.2Zn0.2Co0.2)Cr2O4. Processing: Mechanochemical method using ball milling, followed by calcination at 550 °C for 2 h. Test conditions: C3H6 oxidation reaction in dry and humid conditions (4.2 vol% H2O). Mechanism: The high entropy structure of the material leads to a lower Gibbs free energy, which enhances its stability and water resistance. System: High-entropy metal-organic frameworks (HE-MOFs). Processing: Various methods, including solvothermal, hydrothermal, co-precipitation, mechanochemical synthesis, and electrodeposition. System: Pt18Ni26Fe15Co14Cu27 high-entropy alloy nanoparticles supported on carbon (Pt18Ni26Fe15Co14Cu27/C).
